notes:
Teleport, for the GM.

  • A GM-only key, J by default, puts the selected tokens down where the pointer is, with no drag. It is for setting a scene: make a token ready out in the padding round the map, hidden or however it needs to be, then put it where it belongs. Nothing is walked, so there is no route, ruler, trail, hop or footstep, walls and terrain are not in the way, and no movement is spent.
  • A group lands as a group. The middle of the selection goes to the pointer and every token keeps its place round it, on a space of its own. A group put down at the edge of the canvas is slid back onto it whole.
  • Hold Shift to land off the grid. Ctrl+Z takes a teleport back. Locked tokens stay where they are. With Token Mounting, teleporting a rider teleports its mount and everyone on it.
  • Players cannot bind or trigger the key, and nobody's view moves.
  • The API gains teleportTokens.
  • Checked on Foundry 14.371, which needed no changes here. The fix it brings for hidden tokens showing their measured movement to players covers this module's trail as well.
